lines: How can you tell the difference between a hard-boiled egg and a raw egg without breaking them?
You will find that the hard-boiled egg spins so easily, while the raw one doesn’t.
Also, you will notice that the raw egg will spin more slowly and it will shake.
This is because the raw egg is fluid inside, while the hard-boiled egg is solid.
When you spin the raw egg, the fluid inside moves around and causes the shaking.
But the hard-boiled egg has no fluid, so it doesn’t shake.
Put your finger briefly on the eggs to stop them from spinning.
When you take your finger away, the raw egg will continue to spin for a few more seconds as the fluid inside is still moving.
The hard-boiled egg will stop instantly.
